caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a distinctive shape. The table has four straight, tapered legs and a half-oval shaped top with a central inward curve at the back. The wood is a reddish-brown color with a visible grain pattern. The table appears to have an additional shallow, rounded extension on the right side. The background is a plain, light beige color. The artist's signature, "Heinz Meyers," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Card Table
